headline: Callums Cape Erupts Anew; Mooring County Grinds On
war_summary: Since our last edition the fire has shifted. Callums Cape, briefly quieter at our previous filing, has surged back: some seventeen thousand Colonial and sixteen thousand Warden casualties in a day, the hourly toll still climbing near nine hundred apiece, and flags moving as late as this dispatch, Lookout, Naofa and Callum's Keep the busiest grounds, the count standing five Colonial to one Warden with one base in ruin. Mooring County grinds on without pause; the tally reads six Colonial to five Warden with one base in no-man's-land, The Wind Hills and Wiccwalk the most disputed grounds. Weathered Expanse has re-ignited, the count now three apiece with three bases destroyed, one Warden flag more than at our last filing, and the guns quickening once more. Linn Mercy shows two bases now in ruin among seven Colonial and two Warden, Outwich Ranch and Lathair fought over within the hour. Callahans Passage records no flag movement, yet its casualty ledger climbs steeply, while Marban Hollow, contested through the night, has gone quiet these six hours. Elsewhere the lines hold: four strategic posts in five fly Colonial colours on this 811th day of a war needing thirty-four victory towns, with no victor declared.
